name: setGain
note: No clamp anywhere in the engine — the wire comment's 0…2 is the UI range.

name: setGain-beyond-ui
note: Proves the absence of a clamp: 5.0 must survive intact.

name: setVolume-clamp
note: Engine clamps 0…3 — NOT 0…2 as the wire comment claimed.

name: setToneQ-clamp
note: Engine clamps 0.5…18 — not 0.7…16.

name: setPitch-clamp
note: ±96 QUARTER-tones (= ±48 semitones).

name: setFineTune-clamp
note: ±50 cents.

name: setChokeGroup-clamp
note: 0…8, clamped in the HANDLER.

name: setSwing
note: The handler divides by 100 before the mutator clamps 0…1.

name: setPatternStart
note: Clamped to 0…stepCount-1; 0 encodes as null on the wire.

name: toggleMute
note: isMuted only — solo does NOT interact.

name: setVoiceMode
note: String raw value.

name: setStereoMode
note: mono=0 stereo=1 left=2 right=3.

name: setSampleOut-off
note: Writes trackType (.audio ↔ .midiOut), NOT a bool field.

name: setSend-each
note: index 1…4, clamped 0…1 in the handler AND the mutator.

name: setTone-bipolar
note: In .tone the value is bipolar −100…100.

name: setToneFilterMode-to-lowPass
note: Switching to a filter mode stores |v|.

name: setToneFilterMode-lowPass-back-to-tone
note: LP is the ONLY mode that maps back to a NEGATIVE tone. Easiest bug to write.

name: setToneFilterMode-highPass-back-to-tone
note: HP/BP/Notch map back POSITIVE — the opposite of LP.

name: setTone-in-filter-mode
note: In a filter mode the engine stores the ABSOLUTE value.

name: setFreeRate
note: freeRateEnabled is DERIVED (r != 1.0).

name: setFreeRate-deadzone
note: |r−1| < 0.01 snaps to exactly 1.0 and DISABLES.

name: stepSpeed-faster
note: Snaps up the 17-entry detent table.

name: stepSpeed-clamps-at-top
note: No wrap at the ends.

name: setSpeedMultiplier-detent
note: Snaps to a detent within 0.01.

name: setSpeedMultiplier-offtable-is-NOOP
note: ⚠️ Not clamped — a value off the table is a SILENT NO-OP.

name: resetSpeed
note: Back to 1.0 unconditionally.

name: setSpeedMode
note: 0 = timeOnly, 1 = timeAndPitch (timeStretch is rejected).

name: cycleSubMode-REG-x1
note: REG: none → stretch (loopEnabled must stay off).

name: cycleSubMode-REG-x2
note: REG: stretch → loop. ⊕ — turning loop ON clears stretch.

name: cycleSubMode-OWN-x1
note: OWN: none → chop (a different cycle from REG).

name: setDefaultChop-clears-loop
note: ⚠️ COUPLED: a chop index ≥ 0 turns loopEnabled OFF.

name: setChopCount-WIPES-points
note: ⚠️ A count change resets ALL 8 points to −1 and clamps defaultChopIndex + every cellChopIndex.

name: setChopPoint
note: Clamped to the sample duration (a RUNTIME input).

name: setChopPoint-clamp-to-duration
note: Beyond the sample → duration − 1.

name: resetChopPoint
note: Back to the −1 sentinel (auto-distribute).

name: setDefaultChop-clamp
note: −1 … activeChopCount−1.

name: setSampleStart-rebases-offsets
note: Moving the start shifts every non-zero per-cell start offset by the delta.

name: setLoopStart-clamped
note: clampLoopParameters re-fits loop to the sample window.

name: adjustLocatorStart-keeps-length
note: True modulo — it WRAPS.

name: adjustLocatorLength
note: Also re-clamps the start into range as a side effect.

name: adjustLocatorLength-clamp
note: 1 … euclideanSteps.

name: clearCellParameter-volume-clears-mixVolumeOffsets
note: ⚠️ CROSSED: `volume` clears mixVolumeOffsets, `gain` clears volumeOffsets.

name: clearCellParameter-gain-clears-volumeOffsets
note: ⚠️ The other half of the crossing.

name: clearCellParameter-cellLength-nulls-wrap
note: ⚠️ Also sets wrapSourceStep = nil.

name: setStepCount-shrink
note: Truncates and STASHES the removed tail.

name: setStepCount-grow-restores-the-tail-ROUNDTRIP
note: ⚠️ THE FEATURE: shrink then grow and the steps you had COME BACK — not new empties.

name: setStepCount-grow-past-the-stash
note: Beyond what was stashed, the new steps are empty.

name: setStepCount-clamps-an-overhanging-cell
note: A cell reaching past the new end is CLAMPED, and its original length remembered.

name: setStepCount-restores-the-clamped-cell
note: ⚠️ …and grow back, and the clamped cell returns to its FULL original length.

name: setStepCount-refits-the-locator
note: The locator re-fits to the new pattern.

name: setStepCount-clamp-1-64
note: The HANDLER clamps 1…64.

name: cyclePlaybackMode-to-OWN-flattens-cells
note: ⚠️ Entering OWN FLATTENS every multi-step cell to length 1 (OWN has no extensions).

name: cyclePlaybackMode-back-to-REG-restores-cells-ROUNDTRIP
note: ⚠️ …and leaving OWN puts the lengths back, from a stash that is on NO wire.

name: cyclePlaybackMode-restores-extension-values-ROUNDTRIP
note: The extension steps' per-cell values are restored too.
